title: Molecular imaging-guided discovery of a potent natural FAPα inhibitor for liver fibrosis therapy
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 11 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-75493-9

The authors have developed a dual-modal imaging probe targeting FAPα in liver fibrosis thus identified sappanchalcone as an FAPα inhibitor that attenuated liver fibrosis in murine models.\

title: Distinct roles of the JADE and BRPF scaffolding subunits of the acetyltransferase HBO1 complex
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 11 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-75379-w

HBO1 is a human acetyltransferase complex that includes paralogs of JADE and BRPF as scaffolding subunits. Here, the authors report the distinct mechanisms by these subunits drive HBO1’s association with chromatin and regulate its enzymatic activity.

title: High temperature Nb-Si alloys using data science: optimization of fracture toughness and high-temperature strength
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 10 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-75353-6

Nb-Si alloys are candidates for high-temperature use but rarely combine fracture toughness with high-temperature strength. Here, the authors use machine learning to design an alloy surpassing all reported as-cast Nb-Si alloys in both properties.

title: Energy intensity, offshoring and the illusion of decarbonization
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 10 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-74721-6

This study shows that declining national energy intensity of GDP does not always imply global decarbonization, as its reductions often stem from offshoring energy-intensive production, highlighting the need to account for global supply chains.

title: Scalable fabrication of transparent sodium calcium silicate glass-ceramics by structural engineering overcoming anisotropy barriers
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 10 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-75474-y

Researchers achieve scalable production of large, highly crystalline transparent glass-ceramics via Zr4+ substitution, which mitigates thermal expansion anisotropy and stabilizes high-temperature phases for practical application.

title: Reversible hydrogen storage in reactive hydride composites under 400 K
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 10 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-75313-0

Lightweight complex hydrides offer high storage densities but need high release temperatures. The work presented here details a reactive hydride composite system tuning LiBH₄ in Mg(NH₂)₂–LiH to enable a 3.1 wt% reversible H₂ release below 400 K.

title: High-throughput characterization of transcription factors that modulate UV damage formation and repair at single-nucleotide resolution
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 10 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-75115-4

Transcription factors can promote UV-induced mutagenesis by altering both DNA damage formation and repair. Here, the authors systematically dissect these mechanisms across hundreds of human transcription factors, revealing widespread and highly context-dependent mutagenic effects.

title: A unifying equation for fermentation sustainability across the titer-rate-yield landscape
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 10 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-75285-1

Industrial fermentation’s success hinges on improving titer, rate, and yield (TRY), but how TRY relates to system cost is unknown. Here, the authors map the performance of 32 biomanufacturing facilities and find a generalizable mathematical equation relating TRY and system cost.
